title: Combined output length bound
statement: For every bit string $w$, run the two specified one-pass transducers on $w$: the first outputs true bits while reading the initial run of true bits, and the second outputs the suffix following the first false bit (or the empty word if there is no false bit). The sum of the lengths of these two outputs is at most $|w|$.
